definitions.full: H1153. Besay בֵּסַי proper name, masculine head of a family of Nethinim , בְּנֵיבֵֿסַי Neh 7:52 = בֵֿסָ֑י׳ב Ezra 2:49 . בסר ( be too early , Arabic , compare Aramaic בְּסִירָה half-ripe ).
